counts: Counts named in the guides (42 Shooting Range challenges, 14 Top Fun locations, 9 activity types, 18 meditation spots, 52 areas, 9 gangs, 8 garage properties, 500 choices) are the counts PlayStation tracks, as listed by Exophase.
list: The official 55 trophies, names, descriptions and grades as published by PlayStation and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles, frozen 2026-11-18. 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden.

trophies.guide: This is the platinum, and it pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through the roadmap in order, story first, then side strands, activities, collectibles and cleanup. Check the progress bar at the top of this guide: when it reads 54 of 55, this one is next.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing and finish it. This is the first story mission, so it unlocks naturally at the start of the game and cannot be missed. If you are starting fresh, just follow the on screen prompts until the mission ends.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Play through every story mission in Chapter 1 until the chapter closes. Chapter trophies unlock in order as the story advances, so keep taking the next story mission marker. Nothing here is optional, and a missed side activity never blocks a chapter trophy.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Finish all of Chapter 2 the same way: follow the story missions in order until the chapter ends. The name is censored with asterisks exactly as PlayStation publishes it. Keep pushing the main story and this pops when the chapter closes.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Complete every story mission in Chapter 3. By this point you will have both protagonists and the full map opening up, so use the gaps between missions to pick up collectibles nearby. The trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 in full. This is the last numbered chapter before the finale, so expect longer missions and bigger set pieces. Once the chapter closes, only the final mission stands between you and the gold story trophy.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Play the final story mission to its end. This is the gold trophy for finishing the story, and it unlocks as soon as the credits roll on that mission. Before you start it, consider clearing any missable trophies first, since some one time moments may sit behind you by then.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in your mission list. Story missions can be replayed from the pause menu if you ever fail one, so a failed attempt costs nothing. The trophy pops at the mission's end.
trophies.name: Trust
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions tend to have a setup phase first, so finish any setup jobs the game gives you, then run the heist itself. The trophy unlocks when the heist mission completes.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Take it when its marker appears and play it through to the end. Like other story missions, it is not missable: it waits in your mission list until you play it.
trophies.name: Family Matters
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. The name hints at a big public moment, so expect a loud set piece and follow the mission objectives as they update. Finish the mission and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at the Vice City airport. The name points to taking down something at the airport, so keep moving and use cover when the shooting starts. The trophy unlocks when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The operation name suggests a military style assault, so stock up on ammo and armour before you start it. Finish the mission and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Reach 100 percent completion, which the game tracks across story, side missions, activities and collectibles. This is the last big gold before the platinum, and it usually pops together with the final cleanup trophies. Use the in game stats page to find which category is still short, then clear it with this guide's checklist.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts, which the game counts every time you land a jump, near miss, drift or other stunt move. Stunts add up passively while you drive fast and take ramps, so do not grind them early. Late in the game, chain jumps off ramps and highway overpasses in a fast car to finish the last ones quickly.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: PlayStation tracked count as listed by Exophase
Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: racing, fishing, shooting range, drone racing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and stunt driving are the kinds the list implies. You do not need to win or master any of them, just sample each one. Tick them off in this guide as you try them so you can see which types are left.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: PlayStation tracked count as listed by Exophase
Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit a shooting range, pick each challenge, and replay any that fall short of gold until the score clears the gold line. Use a steady weapon you are comfortable with and aim for headshots where the scoring rewards them. The trophy pops when the last challenge turns gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: PlayStation tracked count as listed by Exophase
Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Find each race marker, learn its course on a practice run, then race to win: cut corners where the course allows and keep the drone low to hold speed. The trophy pops when the last location is won.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: PlayStation tracked count as listed by Exophase
Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida. Races repeat, but only distinct ones count, so keep picking new race markers instead of replaying a favourite. A fast car with good grip beats raw top speed on most city courses. The trophy pops on your twentieth distinct win.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: PlayStation tracked count as listed by Exophase
Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is a fishing rival, so take the challenge when it is offered and outscore him before the time runs out. This is flagged missable because a rival challenge may only be offered in a limited window: if you see Cal's challenge, play it before moving on with the story. If you miss it, look for a replay or a later rematch before the finale.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game from start to finish. Find an arcade machine, pick a game and play it through to its end screen. Any arcade game counts, so choose the shortest one you enjoy and finish it.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's mission strand through to his final mission. Andy is a side character with a chain of missions: keep taking his jobs whenever his marker appears. The trophy pops when his last mission ends, so do not leave his strand half finished.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's mission strand through to his final mission. Kenton's jobs involve boats and the water, so take his missions as they appear on the map. Finish the last one and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's mission strand through to his final mission. Billy's jobs are about riding, so expect bike based missions and keep his strand moving alongside the story. The trophy pops when his final mission ends.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers appear as question marks on the map: talk to them, take their jobs and follow each strand to its end. You need eight complete strands, not eight single missions, so keep returning to strangers you have already met. The trophy pops when the eighth strand closes.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: PlayStation tracked count as listed by Exophase
Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's mission strand through to his final mission. Randy's jobs are about supply, so expect fetch and delivery work across the map. Take his missions when they appear and finish the last one for the trophy.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's mission strand through to his final mission. Tyrone's jobs are flashy, so expect showpiece missions and keep his strand moving. The trophy pops when his final mission ends.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet scenic places, often on beaches, hilltops and lookouts: visit each one and use the meditate prompt. Work through them region by region so none is left behind, and check the in game stats to see how many are left.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: PlayStation tracked count as listed by Exophase
Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret will point you at a one of a kind animal: track it, get close without spooking it, and take the shot cleanly. This is flagged missable because a unique animal may only appear once: if the hunt fails, reload your last save rather than letting the animal escape. The trophy pops when the hunt is done.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida in shops, houses and odd corners: pick them up as you explore and check your collection to see which sets are nearly done. Finish any three sets and the trophy pops. Save card hunting for the collectibles stage, when you can sweep the map in one pass.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: PlayStation tracked count as listed by Exophase
Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It action at 100 different locations. WAiNK It is a phone photo style action you trigger at marked spots around the map, so keep an eye out for its prompt while exploring. It adds up fast if you trigger it everywhere you go, so do it on the move rather than grinding it at the end.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: PlayStation tracked count as listed by Exophase
Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list. Challenges cover driving, shooting, exploration and more, and many complete on their own during normal play. Open the challenge menu, pick the easiest ones first, and the trophy pops at fifty. This pairs well with the stunts and races grind.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: PlayStation tracked count as listed by Exophase
Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4 star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. Your partner must be present for the whole escape, so pick an open area with escape routes and avoid getting caught. This is flagged missable because it needs your partner beside you: do it during a story stretch where your partner rides along, before the finale. Hide in alleys or switch cars to break line of sight.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back to back with your partner while keeping your wanted level the whole time. Do not lose the cops between shops: keep the wanted level alive, drive straight to the next shop, and rob it fast. This is flagged missable because it needs your partner with you and three shops in a row, so plan a route of three close shops first. If the wanted level drops, start the chain again.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: PlayStation tracked count as listed by Exophase
Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. A vehicle counts as discovered when you first get in it or drive it, so try every new car, bike, boat and truck you see. It adds up naturally across the game, and the trophy pops at one hundred. Check your vehicle list to see what types you still need.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: PlayStation tracked count as listed by Exophase
Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow motion aiming mode: trigger it only when five or more enemies are grouped in front of you, then drop all five before the meter runs out. A busy shootout with enemies in the open is the best chance. If you fall short, retry the same fight.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: PlayStation tracked count as listed by Exophase
Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the Vice City airport: leave the airport by air without a scheduled flight, for example by taking a plane and flying out. This is flagged missable because it reads as a one time airport moment tied to a story beat, so try it the first time you are at the airport with a plane available. If the chance passes, look for a free plane at the airport in free roam before the finale.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Do something hot in the Rhinos, the tanks. The description is a joke, so the exact trigger is not spelled out: the sensible read is to get into a Rhino tank and cause chaos with it, or survive a fight against one. This step is inferred from the official description and is not yet verified in game, so treat the tank as the key: find a Rhino, get in it or take it on, and see what pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at all. Plan it like a quiet job: go in when the shop is calm, avoid cameras and guards, grab the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. This is flagged missable because a botched silent run may lock the attempt for that store: save before you go in, and reload if you are spotted. The trophy pops on a clean getaway.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Bank vaults are big jobs: plan your entry, crack the vault, then lose the wanted level before the trophy counts the robbery. You need five successful escapes, so a failed getaway does not count. Do them one at a time with a fast getaway car ready outside.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: PlayStation tracked count as listed by Exophase
Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida: spot one, stop it, crack it open and grab the cash, then lose the wanted level. A sticky bomb or a hard ram can stop the truck. The trophy pops once you escape clean.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. An area counts once you have visited it, so drive and fly across the whole map, including the swamps, the keys and the small towns outside Vice City. The trophy pops when the last area is discovered. Pair this with the meditation spots and the WAiNK It locations to sweep the map once.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: PlayStation tracked count as listed by Exophase
Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Gangs run hidden operations across Leonida: find one, rob it, then move on to the next gang's turf. You need one per gang, so track which gangs you have hit in this guide. The trophy pops when the ninth gang's operation is robbed.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: PlayStation tracked count as listed by Exophase
Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a beach bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. This is a quiet moment trophy, so do it when you are passing the beach anyway. The trophy pops once the drink and the view register.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the front. The phrase classic style points to the series tradition of driving out through the window. This is flagged missable because a showroom smash may only be possible during a specific story beat, so if you get a chance to drive through a showroom, take it. Save first if you can.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt and Associates bowling alley: go bowling there and finish a game. The follow-through wording suggests completing the bowling action properly, so play a full game rather than quitting halfway. The trophy pops at the end of the game.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal. The description is vague on purpose, so the honest read is that it tracks a partner activity that draws a crowd or goes public, such as a shared stunt or a public moment with your partner. This step is inferred from the official description and is not yet verified in game, so keep playing partner activities and watch for the pop. Try the flashier shared activities first.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Make choices, for better or worse, until PlayStation's tracked count reaches 500. Choices are the small decisions the game offers during missions and free roam: pick one every time the game asks, rather than skipping past. This is flagged missable because story choices can only be made while the story is running: decide often during the story, and do not leave every choice to the end. The trophy pops when the count hits 500.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: PlayStation tracked count as listed by Exophase
Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. The description points to retrying something you failed once and then getting it right, so the natural read is to fail an attempt at a mission or challenge, then succeed on the immediate retry. This step is inferred from the official description and is not yet verified in game. If it does not pop on a mission retry, try a retry on a challenge or activity instead.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Witness something strange. The description is deliberately mysterious, so the trigger is likely a rare world event or an odd encounter somewhere in Leonida. This step is inferred from the official description and is not yet verified in game. Explore odd corners of the map, especially at night, and the moment should find you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by: drive past a pedestrian and hit them with a melee attack from the car. Get up some speed on a quiet street, line up a pedestrian and swing as you pass. The trophy pops on a clean hit. Do it in free roam, not during a mission, so a wanted level does not ruin anything.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from big robberies: take them to a contact who cleans them, and the clean cash counts toward the total. Keep laundering after every bank vault and armored truck job until the total hits $250,000. The trophy pops when the laundered total clears the line.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Money spent on clothes, weapons, food and cars all counts, so just buy what you need as you play and the total climbs. If you are short at the end, buy an expensive car or a round of ammo to top it up. The trophy pops when total spending passes $100,000.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought from the property menu or from for sale signs: buy each one as you can afford it, since they also store your vehicles. This is a money sink, so save it for the cleanup stage when laundering and robberies have filled your wallet. The trophy pops on the eighth purchase.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: PlayStation tracked count as listed by Exophase
Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your in game phone, add a vehicle you own or have discovered, and repeat until ten are registered. Use cheap or common vehicles you already drive, so this costs little. The trophy pops on the tenth registration.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: PlayStation tracked count as listed by Exophase
Inferred from the official description, not yet verified in game
